Tripura Minister Praises TSCBL's 66% Credit-Deposit Ratio for FY'26

A Tripura minister has commended the Tripura State Cooperative Bank Ltd. (TSCBL) for achieving a 66% credit-deposit ratio in the fiscal year 2026. This achievement highlights the bank's performance in lending out deposits.
